title: Room Manifest
description: Declarative contract for an agent-owned room that binds persona, shell layout, notebook state, apps, and reusable skills.

description.description: Short statement of the room's purpose

agent_id.description: Primary PMOVES agent identity owning this room

stage.description: Persistent room lifecycle stage. Transient session state is managed separately by P7.

alter.description: Optional alter or room profile chosen for this manifestation

room_type.description: Primary operating pattern for the room. 'exchange' = financial/economic-exchange floor (e.g. ToKenism public face). Added 2026-07-20 via open-room-lane schema extension — see pmoves/docs/specs/room-manifest-schema-extensions-2026-07-20.md, pending operator signoff per AGNOTE4482 §1348.

owner_mode.description: Identity mode for the room session

access.description: Room privacy and content posture. Governs the room INTERNALLY; public egress is enforced separately by policies.publish.egress_redaction_floor.

content_rating.description: 'uncensored' means unrestricted authentic expression inside the room — not a pornography flag.

meta.description: Versioned room metadata used by control-plane integrations.

chit.description: Cryptographic Handshake for Identity & Trust activation metadata.

card_id.description: Active signing card used for the current room activation posture.

kind.description: Panel kind. 'browser' = webview/iframe surface for external apps (e.g. ToKenism simulator, Firefly ledger). Added 2026-07-20 via open-room-lane schema extension — see pmoves/docs/specs/room-manifest-schema-extensions-2026-07-20.md, pending operator signoff per AGNOTE4482 §1348.

action_namespace.description: Structured action namespace the room can call into

status.description: Lifecycle status of the app surface. Planned apps render as inactive in the room UI.

thread_ref.description: Optional default conversation thread or page identifier

role.description: Persona roles within the room (e.g. co-creator, witness)

register.description: Voice register cues (e.g. uncensored, signifying, poetic)

twin_target.description: Identity this persona is a digital twin of, if any

model_routing.description: Model routing plane for this room

gate_param.description: Name of the geometry-state param that gates external publish (e.g. publish_gate).

egress_redaction_floor.description: Fail-closed redaction applied to ALL public egress regardless of room rating. Cannot be bypassed by opening the gate.

team_refs.description: Agent team identifiers from agent-teams.yaml that this room coordinates

service_refs.description: Docker Compose service names or service catalog slugs this room depends on

launcher_refs.description: Pinokio launcher or make target identifiers for room bringup

meta.description: Free-form room metadata. Currently used for inline CHIT signing-card references (see fordham.room.community) and any other operator-level annotations. Sub-objects like 'meta.chit' should mirror the canonical signing-card fields (card_id, creator_id, etc.) from pmoves/contracts/schemas/identity/signing-card.v1.schema.json. Added 2026-07-20 via open-room-lane schema extension — see pmoves/docs/specs/room-manifest-schema-extensions-2026-07-20.md, pending operator signoff per AGNOTE4482 §1348.

room_purpose.description: Social / topological role the room plays in the PMOVES lattice. Distinct from `room_type` (which is the operating pattern, e.g. 'creator'/'scout'/'hybrid'); `room_purpose` answers 'who comes here and why'. Examples: 'community' for Fordham/pilot rooms where residents ask questions, 'studio' for full creator surfaces (e.g. creator-studio.room.collab), 'control' for ops/infra rooms, 'intake' for help desks that route to other rooms. Added 2026-07-27 via creator-collab-lane — see pmoves/docs/specs/creator-collab-room-extensions-2026-07-27.md.

creator_surface.description: How the ComfyUI / Pinokio creator surface shows up in the room. 'primary' = full collab canvas (prompt queue + live progress + artifact gallery + whiteboard), 'ambient' = chat-overlay only (small 'render this' button next to chat, no main panel), 'background' = no UI on the desktop but the skill runs on explicit agent request, 'off' = not available. Every room gets the comfy-mesh-skill bound; this field just tunes the UI mode. Added 2026-07-27 via creator-collab-lane.

hardware_requirements.description: Hardware pin the room needs to operate. P7's session-open handler uses this + the current node's profile (from pmoves/config/profiles/) to pick the right physical host for the room session. 'false' for cpu-only rooms (Fordham, helpdesk); 'true' with vram_mb for GPU rooms. Added 2026-07-27 via creator-collab-lane.

gpu.description: Whether the room requires a GPU. Set false for CPU-only rooms (e.g. Fordham, helpdesk); true for rooms that need to render locally.

min_vram_mb.description: Minimum total VRAM the host needs. 0 for CPU rooms; 12000+ for typical ComfyUI workflows; 24000+ for video gen / LoRA training; 120000+ for 120B-class inference.

gpu_arch.description: Allowed NVIDIA compute capabilities. sm_89 = RTX 4090, sm_90 = H100, sm_110 = GB10 (DGX Spark), sm_120 = RTX 5090.

node_roles.description: Fleet node roles (from pmoves/configs/pinokio-network-inventory.yaml) that can host this room. Used by P7 session-open to pick a host.

pinokio_app_refs.description: Pinokio apps the room brings up on launch via `PINOKIO_SCRIPT_AUTOLAUNCH` / `PINOKIO_SCRIPT_REQUIRES`. Each ref resolves to `pmoves/config/pinokio-apps/curated/<slug>.yaml` (or `user/<slug>.yaml`) for endpoint, healthcheck, gpu_required, node_affinity, pinokio_skill_ref. P7 session-open calls `pinokio start <slug>` per app in dependency order, respecting the declared GPU reservations. Added 2026-07-27 via creator-collab-lane.

role.description: primary = the room depends on this app, optional = nice-to-have, fallback = only if primary not available

gpu_reservation_mb.description: VRAM the room reserves for this app when computing room capacity. Used by P7 to refuse to start the room if the host node can't satisfy the union of reservations.
